Enhanced Premium Tax Credits - re: H.R. 247 / S. 46 - Health Care Affordability Act of 2025; H.R. 5145 - Bipartisan Premium Tax Credit Extension Act; and H.R. 1834 - Breaking the Gridlock Act; and ongoing legislative negotiations re: EPTC extension Physician-Owned Hospitals including H.R. 2191 - Physician Led and Rural Access to Quality Care Act; H.R. 3022 - Restoring Rights of Physicians to Own Hospitals Act - re: physician self-referral to physician owned hospitals S. 2355 - Patients Deserve Price Tags Act - re: hospital price transparency requirements Health plan compliance with the No Surprises Act independent dispute resolution process Health Care Affordability / Insurer Practices - re: federal policies impacting patient out-of-pocket costs, premium increases, medical loss ratio (MLR) requirements, and insurer transparency, including vertically integrated plan practices
